verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site says it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite and uses "AI-powered automations to close your books faster." Supporting features back this up: AI that reads and fills in bills, automatic attachment of emailed receipts to card transactions, and transaction categorization and receipt upload through the API, MCP server and agent skills. Missing for 10: no detailed documentation of what the close automations do (e.g. auto-categorization rules, reconciliation, how accounting sync works), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of faster month-end close.
